text: Because pre-public token allocations to cover start-up costs run against the majority view on fair launches, preserving the spirit of fair launch requires that such allocations be fully transparent, announced to the community, and open to a community audit of the books.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Fair Token Launch (2022). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=4015908
abstract: However, in order to maintain the spirit of fair launch, such token allocations before the public launch should be fully transparent and announced to the community with a community audit of the books, as desired.

value: project allocates tokens before the public launch to cover startup costs
